en: It takes me forty minutes to get to work.
es: Me demoro cuarenta minutos en llegar al trabajo.
why: How long something takes is demorarse en.

en: The bus took two hours, but it arrived on time.
es: El bus se demoró dos horas, pero llegó a tiempo.
why: The trip was long, but it was not late: se demoró.

en: How long does it take you to cook? (to a friend)
why: How long it takes is demorarse en.

en: Tomás took a long time to answer the message.
es: Tomás se demoró mucho en contestar el mensaje.
why: Time spent on an action is demorarse en.

en: We took three hours to paint the wall.
es: Nos demoramos tres horas en pintar la pared.
why: Time an action took is demorarse en.
